name: outcome
description: The single result of the call. If more than one applies, pick the first in this order: escalated_to_human (severe distress, request for a person, complaint or stop-calling request), hardship_escalated (job loss, illness, death or similar; collection stopped), dispute_logged (not their loan or wrong amount), paid_already (says they already paid), promise_to_pay (a date and amount agreed), payment_link_sent (link sent, no date agreed), callback_scheduled (callback booked), third_party_or_wrong_number (someone other than the borrower answered), identity_not_verified (could not confirm the borrower), refused_or_abusive (refused or abusive, call ended politely), call_incomplete (call dropped or audio failed before any result).

name: identity_verified
description: True if the identity check passed during the call, false otherwise.

name: third_party_answered
description: True if at any point someone other than the borrower spoke on the call, such as a family member, colleague or a wrong number.

name: ptp_date
description: The promised payment date as YYYY-MM-DD, only if the borrower promised to pay by a date.
conditional_prompt: Only fill this if a promise to pay was agreed.

name: ptp_amount
description: The promised amount in rupees, only if the borrower promised to pay.
conditional_prompt: Only fill this if a promise to pay was agreed.

name: hardship_flag
description: True if the borrower described a hardship such as job loss, illness, a medical emergency or a death in the family.

name: hardship_category
description: The kind of hardship the borrower described. income_drop covers business loss or reduced pay.
conditional_prompt: Only fill this if the borrower described a hardship.

name: dispute_flag
description: True if the borrower said they already paid, that the loan is not theirs, or that the amount is wrong.

name: language_used
description: The main language the borrower spoke. hinglish means a real mix of Hindi and English in the same sentences.

name: escalated
description: True if the case was handed to a person on the collections team, whether by transfer or a queued callback.

name: escalation_reason
description: Why the case was handed to a person. plan_change_request covers waivers, discounts, settlements and dates more than seven days away.
conditional_prompt: Only fill this if the case was handed to a person.
